text:
nina: heads-up: promo for build 6342 is paused by cache index verify failure at 10:12 PT. https://ci.example.com/builds/6342
omar: logs show index checksum mismatch when assembling artifact bundle. snippet:
```
VERIFY index: checksum expected=0x9f7a, found=0x2b3c
error: index integrity failure
```
deploy-bot: auto-retries exhausted; promotion state=PAUSED.
ci-bot: promotion blocked; will not auto-promote until manual override.
pm-julia: we have a customer webinar at 10:40 PT. can we meet the 10:30 change-window?
sre-oncall: storage reports a partial index rewrite during background compaction; artifacts themselves verified but index stamps/csum mismatched. short-term safe option: promote last-stable digest to canary.
omar: alternatives: wait for storage to finish reindex (~25min) and retry, or pin previous image sha256:5a6b7c to hit the window. forcing through ignore-check is risky.
nina: leaning to pin for the window and quarantine 6342 for a controlled reupload. @deploy-bot promote sha256:5a6b7c to canary and tag 6342 quarantine. include reason "index verify failure".
deploy-bot: executing: `deploybot promote --env canary --image sha256:5a6b7c --reason "index verify failure build 6342"`
deploy-bot: promote complete. canary now on sha256:5a6b7c; routing updated. promotion_log: /deploy/logs/6123587421/promote-5a6b7c
sre-oncall: will coordinate reindex and integrity replay; CI will re-run artifact assembly for 6342 after storage confirms index normalized.
pm-julia: thanks, tagging webinar contacts. nina/ticket-owner please update release notes and open follow-up INC.
nina: will file INC-9021 and update notes. change-window met. closing thread unless storage reports repeat issues.
